blocks.text: FICTIONAL SAMPLE - NOT FOR FILING OR PAYMENT
Use the following supplied assumptions for the fictional preparation worksheet. These instructions do not establish that the adjustments are legally allowable or that the return is complete.
Reverse $480.00 of organization costs included in book cost of revenue. The prior deduction was $480.33. Preserve the $0.33 difference for review; do not post a balancing entry.
